# statistics.types: OutlierDetection

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> An outlier test. Each statistic carries its threshold in its own native
> scale: standard deviations for ZScore
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard\_score), interquartile-range
> multiples beyond the quartiles for Iqr, and median-absolute-deviation
> multiples for Mad (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Median\_absolute\_deviation).
